name: Beechcraft Bonanza G36
_note: MEDIUM confidence. Limits and approach 79 KIAS (flaps 30), VR 73, Vy 100 from the G36 POH figures as summarised by rotatepilot.com (POH 2008 rev 2011, sections 1-4; cross-checked against AOPA's 2013 G36 data table: Vs1 68, Vne 205). VFE is 154 at approach flaps (12 deg) and 124 at full flaps (30 deg); the lower value is stored. Circuit bands are typical practice. Retractable gear: gear calls and the 154 KIAS gear limit are not modelled. Flap handle positions in MSFS were not checked in-sim. The Bonanza V35 is a different profile (not included).

meta.change_note: New profile. Limits, rotate and approach speed from the G36 POH figures; circuit bands are typical practice.
